# EdgeNeXt

**Category:** Efficient/Mobile · **Code:**
[`timm/models/edgenext.py`](https://github.com/huggingface/pytorch-image-models/blob/main/timm/models/edgenext.py) ·
**Architectures:** 5 · **Pretrained weights:** 6 (6 with ImageNet-1k results)

EdgeNeXt is a hybrid CNN-Transformer for mobile devices that combines depthwise convolution encoders with split
depth-wise transpose attention (SDTA) encoders, which apply attention across channels.

## Papers

* [EdgeNeXt: Efficiently Amalgamated CNN-Transformer Architecture for Mobile Vision
  Applications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2206.10589)
* [Solving ImageNet: a Unified Scheme for Training any Backbone to Top Results](https://arxiv.org/abs/2204.03475)

## Usage

See the [Quickstart](../quickstart) for loading pretrained weights, image preprocessing and fine-tuning, and [Feature
Extraction](../feature_extraction) for using the models as backbones.

```py
>>> import timm
>>> model = timm.create_model('edgenext_base.in21k_ft_in1k', pretrained=True)
>>> data_config = timm.data.resolve_model_data_config(model)
```

| [`dynamic_img_size=True`](../model_api#input-size) | – |
| [`set_grad_checkpointing()`](../model_api#training-hooks) | ✓ |
| [Layer-wise LR decay (`group_matcher()`)](../model_api#training-hooks) | ✓ |
| [`reset_classifier()`](../model_api#classifier) | ✓ |

✓ supported, ✓ (square) works for square sizes only, ✗ not supported, – not needed (the model already accepts any input
size). Checked by running each feature on a randomly initialized model (`EdgeNeXt` with `edgenext_xx_small` at 256),
other architectures of the same class are expected to behave the same. See the [Model API](../model_api) page for
details.
